_comment: Build-phase static SARB ZARONIA (ZAR Overnight Index Average) seed — daily ZARONIA rates for business days from 2026-01-02 through 2026-05-27. ZARONIA is the SA Risk-Free Rate (RFR) benchmark, published by SARB at 17:00 SAST. Rates are in decimal form (e.g. 0.0818 = 8.18%). Used by the build-phase ZARONIA ingester (platform/market-data/sarb-zaronia-ingester.ts) to seed raw rate ticks into MarketDataStore for IRS pricing and ALM discount curve construction.
_authority: D-PRODUCT-CONSTRUCTION-SLICES-4-8 (CEO session-delegation 2026-05-26); D-PRODUCT-CONSTRUCTION-SUBSTRATE Slice 7 (ZARONIA feed blocker for IRS model); Policies/market-risk-policy-v1.md; Team/Ravi.md (ZARONIA conventions).
_provenance: Build-phase fixture variant. Production SARB ZARONIA ingestion (live SARB API or website scrape) is sequenced post-licence. Ticks carry provenance='production' in MarketDataStore (SARB is a regulator-grade source) and fixingVariant='build-phase-fixture' in payload.
_rate_regime: Jan–Mar 2026: SARB Repo 8.25%, ZARONIA approximately repo minus 7bp (~8.18%). Late Mar/Apr 2026: SARB cut repo to 8.00% on 2026-03-26 MPC, ZARONIA transitions to ~7.93%. May 2026: ZARONIA ~7.93% with small daily noise (±1–2bp).
_exclusions: Weekends excluded. SA public holidays excluded: 2026-03-21 (Human Rights Day), 2026-04-03 (Good Friday), 2026-04-06 (Family Day/Easter Monday), 2026-04-27 (Freedom Day), 2026-05-01 (Workers Day).
